Context: 3. Contribution by subscriber.-

The above is extended to the employees of Central Autonomous Bodies covered under NPS. - OM, dated 26-8-2021.  
5. Interest on delayed deposit of contributions.The interest shall be credited to the Individual Pension Account of the employee within a period of thirty days of the crediting of the amount of contribution. The rate of interest for this purpose would be the rate of interest, as decided by the Government from time to time, for the Public Provident Fund deposits.  
- Rule 8.
